name: poppler
description: PDF rendering library with comprehensive utilities for text extraction, conversion, and analysis

pdfinfo.description: PDF document information extractor showing metadata, structure, and technical details
pdfinfo.usage:
pdfinfo document.pdf # Display basic PDF information and metadata
pdfinfo -meta document.pdf # Show XMP metadata
pdfinfo -struct document.pdf # Display document structure
pdfinfo -rawdates document.pdf # Show creation/modification dates in raw format

pdftotext.description: PDF text extraction utility with layout preservation and encoding options
pdftotext.usage:
pdftotext document.pdf output.txt # Extract text to file
pdftotext -layout document.pdf - # Preserve layout to stdout
pdftotext -enc UTF-8 document.pdf # Extract with UTF-8 encoding
pdftotext -f 5 -l 10 document.pdf pages.txt # Extract pages 5-10 only

pdftoppm.description: PDF to PPM/PNG/JPEG image converter with resolution and quality control
pdftoppm.usage:
pdftoppm -png -r 300 document.pdf output # Convert to PNG at 300 DPI
pdftoppm -jpeg -jpegopt quality=95 document.pdf img # High quality JPEG
pdftoppm -f 1 -l 1 -png document.pdf cover # Convert first page only
pdftoppm -scale-to 1024 -png document.pdf thumb # Scale to 1024px width

pdftohtml.description: PDF to HTML converter preserving layout, fonts, and embedded images
pdftohtml.usage:
pdftohtml document.pdf # Convert to HTML with embedded images
pdftohtml -c document.pdf output.html # Complex layout preservation
pdftohtml -s document.pdf simple.html # Simple HTML output
pdftohtml -xml document.pdf data.xml # XML output for data extraction

pdftops.description: PDF to PostScript converter with EPS and font embedding options
pdftops.usage:
pdftops document.pdf output.ps # Convert to PostScript
pdftops -eps document.pdf output.eps # Create Encapsulated PostScript
pdftops -level3 document.pdf modern.ps # Use PostScript Level 3
pdftops -f 1 -l 1 document.pdf page1.ps # Convert first page only

pdfimages.description: PDF image extractor saving embedded images in original format
pdfimages.usage:
pdfimages document.pdf img # Extract all images as img-000.* files
pdfimages -all document.pdf images # Extract with format preservation
pdfimages -png document.pdf pics # Force PNG output format
pdfimages -f 5 -l 10 document.pdf page5-10 # Extract from pages 5-10

pdfunite.description: PDF merge utility combining multiple PDF files into a single document
pdfunite.usage:
pdfunite file1.pdf file2.pdf file3.pdf merged.pdf # Merge multiple PDFs
pdfunite chapter*.pdf book.pdf # Merge using wildcards
pdfunite part1.pdf part2.pdf combined.pdf # Simple two-file merge

pdfseparate.description: PDF page separator extracting individual pages from multi-page documents
pdfseparate.usage:
pdfseparate document.pdf page-%02d.pdf # Split into individual pages
pdfseparate input.pdf output/page-%d.pdf # Split to directory with numbering

pdfattach.description: PDF file attachment utility for embedding files into PDF documents
pdfattach.usage:
pdfattach document.pdf attachment.txt output.pdf # Attach file to PDF
pdfattach -replace document.pdf new_file.zip output.pdf # Replace existing attachment

pdfdetach.description: PDF attachment extractor for saving embedded files from PDF documents
pdfdetach.usage:
pdfdetach -list document.pdf # List all attachments
pdfdetach -save 1 document.pdf # Save first attachment
pdfdetach -saveall document.pdf # Extract all attachments

pdffonts.description: PDF font analyzer listing font information and embedding status
pdffonts.usage:
pdffonts document.pdf # List all fonts used in PDF
pdffonts -subst document.pdf # Show font substitutions
pdffonts -loc document.pdf # Show font locations on pages

pdftocairo.description: PDF to vector graphics converter using Cairo rendering engine for high-quality output
pdftocairo.usage:
pdftocairo -svg document.pdf output.svg # Convert to SVG vector format
pdftocairo -pdf document.pdf optimized.pdf # Re-render PDF with Cairo
pdftocairo -png -r 300 document.pdf image # High-quality PNG rendering
pdftocairo -eps document.pdf vector.eps # Convert to EPS format
